name: Wings Hub
shortDescription: Wings Hub in Scarborough serves halal, lightly dusted wings in 60 flavours, plus loaded fries, wraps, quesadillas and bundles.
description: Wings Hub is a halal wings restaurant in Scarborough, Ontario. We serve lightly dusted wings, sold by the pound in 60 flavours, alongside loaded fries and poutine, wraps, quesadillas, appetizers and bundles for sharing.
